A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a grant to YWCA Minneapolis.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; YWCA MINNEAPOLIS. +]

[+$350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the YWCA Minneapolis to provide training to eligible individuals, including job skills training, career counseling, and job placement assistance necessary to secure a child development associate credential and to have a career path in early education. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a grant to YWCA Minneapolis.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; YWCA MINNEAPOLIS.

$350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the YWCA Minneapolis to provide training to eligible individuals, including job skills training, career counseling, and job placement assistance necessary to secure a child development associate credential and to have a career path in early education.
additions: $350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the YWCA Minneapolis to provide training to eligible individuals, including job skills training, career counseling, and job placement assistance necessary to secure a child development associate credential and to have a career path in early education.
